effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 Digimon card with the [Blue Flare] or [Xros Heart] trait from your hand under any of your Tamers, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When any of your [Blue Flare] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements would be played, by suspending this Tamer, you may place cards from under your Tamers as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
